system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 7. 2 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (48 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.
[b01] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (mocking, condescending): "This is where you live now?"
[b02] GERALD (arrogant, scornful): "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."
[b03] JULIANA (sharp, unintimidated): "You came all this way just to insult my home?"
[b04] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (gloating, mocking): "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."
[b05] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (cruel): "You look like a servant."
[b06] JULIANA (proud, resolute): "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."
[b07] GERALD (biting, condescending): "You were born a lady."
[b08] JULIANA (firm, unapologetic): "And I remain one."
[b09] GERALD (bitter, sneering): "You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."
[b10] JULIANA (passionate, defiant): "I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."
[b11] JULIANA (cold, commanding): "You have no authority here. Leave."
[b12] GERALD (furious, threatening): "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
[b13] GERALD (spiteful, boastful): "And your husband?"

--- WINDOW 1 (27 seconds, code score 0.81) ---
[b00] GERALD (spiteful, boastful): "And your husband?"
[b01] GERALD (snarl): "Where is that beggar husband?"
[b02] ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
[b03] SFX: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
[b04] ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
[b05] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (urgent, annoyed): "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
[b06] GERALD (trembling, trying to save face): "What are you staring at?"
[b07] ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
[b08] GERALD (nervous, hurried): "We are leaving."
[b09] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (outraged, flustered): "Leaving? Gerald!"
[b10] ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
[b11] SFX: Carriage door slamming shut.

Pick the single best promo.
